title: Set a unit and color scheme

blocks.content:
Standard options control how Grafana formats values in your panel. The most important are the unit and color scheme settings.

To set standard options, complete the following steps:

1. Open the panel editor by clicking **Edit** on your panel.
2. In the display options sidebar on the right, scroll to the **Standard options** section.
3. Click the **Unit** dropdown and search for a unit. For example, select **Misc > percent (0-100)** to format values as percentages.
4. Scroll down to **Color scheme** and select **From thresholds (by value)**. This prepares the panel for threshold-based coloring in the next milestone.

The visualization preview updates immediately to show formatted values. Notice how raw numbers are now displayed with the unit you selected.

In the next milestone, you add a threshold for conditional coloring.
